method: Manual transcription of attached Metal HUD screenshots; original PNG files copied byte-for-byte and SHA-256 checked against attachment source files.

user_report.symptoms: Large FPS decrease with upscaling alone; higher memory use than DXMT

images.backend_attribution: DXMT according to user; HUD itself says Metal

comparison_limits: Camera, visible scene content, and potentially workload differ; these screenshots are not a controlled frame-matched A/B.
The second image does not establish its internal rendering resolution or upscaler settings.
The first image does not establish sharpening, HDR flag, backing texture sizes, frames in flight, or game settings other than the shown HUD fields.
Game Mode Off is displayed only in the second screenshot; absence of that field in the first is not proof that its Game Mode is On.
Do not add App and Metal memory values: accounting can overlap in unified memory.
Do not assume GPU timing scopes match across DXMT and D3DMetal, or subtract GPU from Frame Interval and label the result CPU time.
Dispatch and Copy Resource counters describe the shown rendering workload, not automatically FSR-only operations.
A single memory snapshot does not demonstrate a leak, allocation growth, swap, or memory pressure.
FG OFF is the user's reported operating condition; do not substitute FG ON allocation or interpolation costs as the cause.
